[[Skybus Metro|BEML Skybus]]{{Cite web|url=http://www.indiaenvironmentportal.org.in/content/158321/beml-to-make-foray-into-sky-bus-project/|title=BEML to make foray into sky-bus project - India Environment Portal | News, reports, documents, blogs, data, analysis on environment & development | India, South Asia|website=www.indiaenvironmentportal.org.in|accessdate=24 May 2023}} | website = {{URL|https://www.bemlindia.in}} }} '''BEML Limited''', formerly '''Bharat Earth Movers Limited''', is an Indian [[Public sector undertakings in India|public sector undertaking]] which manufactures a variety of heavy equipment, such as that used for earth moving, railways, transport, and mining. It is headquartered in [[Bengaluru]], [[Karnataka]]. BEML is Asia's second-largest manufacturer of earth moving equipment.{{Cite web|url=https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/news/variety/BEML-From-earth-moving-to-aerospace/article20595770.ece|title=BEML: From earth moving to aerospace|publisher=[[The Hindu Business Line]]|date=27 March 2013|access-date=28 March 2013}} Its stock trades on the [[National Stock Exchange of India]] under the symbol "BEML", and on the [[Bombay Stock Exchange]] under the code "500048".{{Cite web|url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/beml-ltd/stocks/companyid-11975.cms|title=BEML Ltd Company in Bombay Stock Exchange (BSE)|publisher=[[The Economic Times]]|date=12 January 2019|access-date=13 January 2019}} [[File:EXCON 2025, Bangalore International Exhibition Centre (18).jpg|thumb|right|BEML at [[EXCON]] 2025, [[Bangalore International Exhibition Centre|BIEC]] ]] ==History== Bharat Earth Movers Limited was incorporated on 11 May 1964 with the help of the [[Soviet Union]].{{cite web | url=https://iide.co/case-studies/marketing-strategy-of-beml/ | title=Extensive Marketing Strategy of BEML - A Complete Analysis }} BEML was wholly owned by the government and operated by India's [[Ministry of Defence (India)|Ministry of Defence]] until 1992, when the government divested 25% of its holdings in the company. The company went for a Follow-on Public offer (FPO) in July 2007 and fixed the price band for its FPO between [[Indian rupee sign|₹]]1,020 and ₹1,090.{{Cite news|url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/markets/ipos/fpos/beml-public-offer-subscribed-around-9-times/articleshow/2170112.cms|title=BEML public offer subscribed around 9 times|newspaper=[[The Economic Times]]|date=3 July 2007|access-date=4 July 2007}} On 5 October, the company changed its name to BEML Ltd.{{cite web|url=https://www.hindustantimes.com/business/bharat-earth-movers-renamed-beml-ltd/story-01pLt7d6CKqYozVUAVXlEN.html |title=Bharat Earth Movers renamed BEML Ltd |newspaper=[[The Hindustan Times]] |date=5 October 2007 |accessdate=5 January 2025}} In December 2019, the [[Government of India]] had given 'in-principle' approval for strategic [[disinvestment]] of BEML Ltd to the extent of 26% out of the Government shareholding of 54.03%, with transfer of management control to a strategic buyer.{{cite web|url=https://pib.gov.in/PressReleseDetail.aspx?PRID=1595015|title=PSU Status of BEML|access-date=5 December 2019}} ==Manufacturing facilities== BEML has manufacturing plants in [[Kolar Gold Fields]], [[Bangalore]], [[Mysore]] and [[Palakkad]]. It has numerous regional offices throughout the country. KGF unit is the main unit accounting for the manufacture and assembly of a wide array of earth-moving equipment, such as [[bulldozer]]s and [[excavator]]s. [[Railcoach]]es are made in the Bengaluru complex, and the Mysore facility makes [[dump truck]]s and engines of various capacities. On 10 August 2020, Defence Minister [[Rajnath Singh]] inaugurated the industrial design centre (IDC) at BEML Bengaluru, aiming to integrate research and development with manufacturing.{{Cite news|agency=Press Trust of India|date=2020-08-10|title=Defence Minister Rajnath Singh launches BEML's industrial design centre|work=Business Standard|url=https://www.business-standard.com/article/current-affairs/defence-minister-rajnath-singh-launches-beml-s-industrial-design-centre-120081001420_1.html|access-date=2020-08-14}} ==Residency== BEML Layout, located in [[Brookefield]], was the company's township for its employees. {{Citation needed|date=January 2026}} ==Products== BEML manufactures a wide range of products to meet the needs of mining, construction, power, irrigation, fertiliser, cement, steel, and rail sectors. The earthmoving equipment includes bulldozers, dump trucks, hydraulic excavators, wheel loaders, rope shovels, walking draglines, motor grader,s and scrapers. BEML has recently introduced road headers and slide discharge Loaders for underground mining applications. Railway products include integral railcoaches, electric multiple units, rail buses, track-laying equipment, and overhead equipment inspection Cars. BEML manufactures heavy-duty trucks and trailers and hydraulic aggregates for the transportation sector. The company also manufactures high-power diesel engines and heavy-duty hydraulic aggregates to meet specific customer requirements. The company plans to diversify into varied activities, including underground mining equipment, underground storage for petro-products, leasing and financial services, and joint ventures abroad.{{Citation needed|date=April 2011}} ==Mining and construction equipment== BEML is India's leading mining and construction equipment manufacturer and Asia's second-largest equipment company, BEML offers a diverse range of mining machinery for both opencast and underground mining. BEML manufactures machines such as [[Excavator|hydraulic excavators]], [[Bulldozer|bulldozers]], [[Loader (equipment)|wheel loaders]], [[Dump truck|dump trucks]], [[Grader|motor grades]], [[Pipelayer|pipelayers]], tyre handler, [[Backhoe loader|backhoe loaders]], [[Power shovel|electric shovels]], load haul dumpers etc. In 2025, BEML unveils a large electric rope shovel named ''BRS21'', which is wholly designed and manufactured in India. It weighs 720 tonnes and has a 21 cubic meter bottom dump bucket.{{cite web | title=BEML completes India-designed & developed large electric rope shovel | date=29 April 2025 | url=https://im-mining.com/2025/04/29/beml-completes-india-designed-developed-large-electric-rope-shovel/ }}{{cite web | title=BEML launches India's largest indigenously developed rope shovel, hands it over to Coal India | date=29 April 2025 | url=https://psuwatch.com/newsupdates/beml-launches-indias-largest-indigenously-developed-rope-shovel }} In the same year, BEML floated an EoI (Expression of Interest) for design consultancy in developing indigenous [[Tunnel boring machine|Tunnel Boring Machines]]. Reportedly, initial discussions have already been initiated by the company with firms from [[Austria]] and [[Japan]].{{Cite web |title=State-run BEML has plans to make Tunnel Boring Machines to cut dependence on China |url=https://www.moneycontrol.com/news/business/companies/state-run-beml-has-plans-to-make-tunnel-boring-machines-to-cut-dependence-on-china-13495488.html |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250829071749/https://www.moneycontrol.com/news/business/companies/state-run-beml-has-plans-to-make-tunnel-boring-machines-to-cut-dependence-on-china-13495488.html |archive-date=2025-08-29 |access-date=2025-09-02 |website=Moneycontrol |language=en-US}} ==Defense and aerospace== [[File:15_Metre_Sarvatra_Bridging_System_passes_through_the_Rajpath_during_the_full_dress_rehearsal_for_the_Republic_Day_Parade-2013,_in_New_Delhi_on_January_23,_2013.jpg|thumb|[[DRDO Sarvatra]] Bridge System produced by BEML]] BEML plays a key role in the country's [[Integrated Guided Missile Development Programme]] by supplying ground support vehicles. A new Aerospace division was launched during [[List of Aero India editions#7th edition (2009)|Aero India 2009]]. The division manufactures ground support equipment such as aircraft towing tractors, aircraft weapon loading trolleys, Multi-purpose weapon loaders, and crash fire tenders. === DATRAN 1500 === As reported in 2010, an indigenous engine, capable of providing a power output of {{Convert|1500|hp|abbr=on}} was to be developed for [[DRDO]]'s [[Future Main Battle Tank]] (FMBT) programme. A national team had been formed, including members from academia, the user, industry, and the DRDO. The prototype would be ready by 4-5 yrs. Another project to develop the [[automatic transmission system]] for the tank was being launched. The indigenous engine, along with the transmission, will collectively form the '''Bharat Power Pack''' which will meet the FMBT's mobility requirements.{{Cite news |last=Shukla |first=Ajai |date=2010-08-10 |title=DRDO to develop army's next-generation tank |url=https://www.business-standard.com/article/economy-policy/drdo-to-develop-army-s-next-generation-tank-110081000023_1.html |access-date=2021-07-06 |work=Business Standard India}}{{Cite news |date=2010-11-04 |title=1,500-horsepower FMBT to replace T-72 tanks beyond 2020 |url=https://www.thehindu.com/news/national/1500-horsepower-FMBT-to-replace-T-72-tanks-beyond-2020/article15675648.ece |access-date=2025-01-03 |work=The Hindu |language=en-IN |issn=0971-751X}} As of 2012, DRDO had launched a “mission mode” project to develop the engine. The development project includes companies like [[Kirloskar Group|Kirloskar Oil Engines]], BEML, and the [[Mahindra & Mahindra]]; research institutions like [[Indian Institutes of Technology]] (IITs); and bodies like the [[Automotive Research Association of India]], [[Pune]]. An Indian “prime contractor” would assemble the engines from sub-components delivered by a network of sub-contractors. As reported, the DRDO had been trying to bring in international consultants for assistance in designing the engine. By then, German companies MTU and Renk had refused to provide consultancy and, as of then, consultancy proposals from Ricardo of Britain and AVL of Austria were being evaluated. DRDO had also issued an Expression of Interest (EoI) to select an Indian partner to manufacture the engine. The selected consultant will work in a consortium including DRDO, the Army (user), and the Indian manufacturing partner. As per the 2012 timeline, the programme includes 12 months for designing, an additional 18 months for prototype development – a total of 30–36 months to begin testing of the prototype.{{Cite news |date=2012-01-02 |title=Army dithers over futuristic tank, DRDO pursues engine |url=https://www.business-standard.com/article/economy-policy/army-dithers-over-futuristic-tank-drdo-pursues-engine-112010200118_1.html |access-date=2025-01-03 |work=Business Standard}} As of February 2024, reports suggest the German-origin engine of [[Arjun (tank)|Arjun Mk1A]] variant will be replaced by the DATRAN 1500 engine, which is being developed by DRDO and is currently under testing phase. This is because of the sudden closure of [[MTU Friedrichshafen]]'s supply chain, which is expected to take four years more to restart.{{Cite news |last=Pubby |first=Manu |date=2024-02-14 |title=India to develop engine for new Arjun tanks |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/news/defence/india-likely-to-use-indigenous-engines-in-arjun-tanks-as-german-engines-getting-delayed-by-four-years/articleshow/107667794.cms?from=mdr |access-date=2025-01-03 |work=The Economic Times |issn=0013-0389}}{{Cite news |date=2024-02-13 |title=India likely to use indigenous engines in Arjun tanks as German engines getting delayed by 4 years |url=https://www.aninews.in/news/world/asia/india-likely-to-use-indigenous-engines-in-arjun-tanks-as-german-engines-getting-delayed-by-4-years20240213204209/ |access-date=2025-01-03 |work=[[Asian News International|ANI]]}}{{Cite web |last=Dangwal |first=Ashish |date=2024-02-19 |title=Germany 'Derails' Arjun Mk-1A Tank Project By 'Delaying' Engines; Indian Military Experts Decode MTU Move |url=https://www.eurasiantimes.com/germany-derails-arjun-mk-1a-tank-project-by-delaying/ |access-date=2024-02-19 |website=The EurAsian Times |language=en-US}} The DATRAN 1500 engine had its first test in 2023. On 20 March 2024, the prototype engine was again successfully tested at BEML's Engine Division [[Mysore|Mysuru]] facility. The engine has electronic control, a self-cleaning air filter, [[CRDi]] [[Fuel injection|fuel injection system]], and electronic warning control. In addition, the engine has a high [[power-to-weight ratio]] and can run in a variety of harsh environments, such as over {{Convert|5000|m|ft|abbr=on}} [[above mean sea level]], in sub-zero temperature of −40 °C, and up to +55 °C in a hot desert environment. A total of 20 prototypes of the engines, with an emphasis on technology stabilization, will be produced in 2024 and put through additional testing to evaluate their performance, robustness, and dependability. The project is expected to be completed by the middle of 2025.{{Cite web |date=10 October 2025 |title=2023-24 Annual Report |url=https://mod.gov.in/sites/default/files/AR_2023-24-new-23-9-2025.pdf |access-date=10 October 2025 |website=Ministry of Defence, Government of India}}{{Cite news |last= |first= |date=2024-03-20 |title=Indigenously developed 1500 HP prototype engine for future main battle tanks test fired |url=https://www.thehindu.com/news/national/karnataka/indigenously-developed-1500-hp-prototype-engine-for-future-main-battle-tanks-test-fired/article67971759.ece |access-date=2024-03-20 |work=The Hindu |language=en-IN |issn=0971-751X}}{{Cite news |last=Pubby |first=Manu |date=2024-02-14 |title=India to develop engine for new Arjun tanks |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/news/defence/india-likely-to-use-indigenous-engines-in-arjun-tanks-as-german-engines-getting-delayed-by-four-years/articleshow/107667794.cms?from=mdr |access-date=2024-03-20 |work=The Economic Times |issn=0013-0389}}{{Cite news |date=2024-03-20 |title=Transformative moment: BEML successfully test fires indigenous 1500 HP engine for military tanks |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/news/defence/india-successfully-test-fires-indigenous-1500-hp-engine-for-military-tanks/articleshow/108650928.cms?from=mdr |access-date=2024-03-20 |work=The Economic Times |issn=0013-0389}} The Bharat Power Pack weighs {{Convert|2200|kg|lb|abbr=on}}.{{Cite tweet |number=1279402941636464642 |user=Amitraaz |title=CVRDE's Bharat power pack... It will replace the existing... |first=Amiet |last=Kashyap |date=2020-07-04 |access-date=2025-07-28}} After initial trials, the performance of the engine is to be tested onboard a modified Arjun MBT prototype which would be heavier than the in-service [[main battle tanks]] of the Army or the MBTs the engine would power (Arjun variants, [[Future Main Battle Tank|FMBT]] and [[Future Ready Combat Vehicle|FRCV]]). The engine could also be integrated on [[T-90#India|T-90MkIII]] (an advanced Indian variant) from 2027–28.{{Cite web |title=Overcoming engine woes: India's tank engine sees progress |url=https://www.orfonline.org/expert-speak/overcoming-engine-woes-india-s-tank-engine-sees-progress |access-date=2025-01-10 |website=orfonline.org |language=en}} The director of [[CVRDE]], the nodal laboratory under DRDO for the programme, had formally commenced the integration activities of the DATRAN Test Vehicle on 4 December 2025 by mounting one of the subsystems. The DATRAN Test Vehicle is a [[Testbed|test platform]] for vehicle trials of the indigenous 1500 hp DATRAN transmission and the 1500 hp engine being developed by CVRDE. The power pack is in an advanced stage of development. Meanwhile, the testbed is being developed as the precursor for future [[Armoured fighting vehicle|AFV]] platforms. Shri S Srinivasa Rao is the Program Director (Powerpack) and Project Director (DATRAN-1500) whereas Shri S Mathi is the Project Manager (DATRAN-1500).{{Cite web |date=January 2026 |title=DRDO Newsletter January 2026 |url=https://drdo.gov.in/drdo/sites/default/files/publication-document/NL_Jan2026.pdf |access-date=6 January 2026 |website=drdo.gov.in |page=12 |quote=DATRAN Test Vehicle – Commencement of integration}}{{Cite tweet |number=2007767399974707558 |user=cvkrishnan |title=It looks like the CVRDE DATRAN 1500 HP engine has completed all lab testing, design mods and performance tuning in AVL UK and is back here for integration and testing for field trials. |author=Krishnan |date=2026-01-04 |access-date=2026-01-06}} === TRAWL Assembly === BEML and the Electro Pneumatics and Hydraulics (India) Private Limited received a contract worth around {{INRConvert|975|c|lk=on|year=2026}} from the [[Indian Army]] to supply TRAWL Assembly, designed by [[DRDO]], for its [[T-72]] and [[T-90]] fleet. The acquisition is aimed at enhancing the [[minefield]] breaching capability for the Armoured Corps. They will create Vehicle Safe Lanes through minefields with anti-tank mines by employing proximity magnetic fuses.{{Cite press release |title=Aatmanirbhar Bharat: MoD inks Rs 975 crore contracts for TRAWL Assembly for T-72/T-90 Tanks to enhance Indian Army’s minefield breaching capability |date=2026-04-21 |publisher=[[Press Information Bureau]] |url=https://www.pib.gov.in/PressReleasePage.aspx?PRID=2254141®=3&lang=1 |access-date=2026-04-21}}{{Cite web |last=PTI |date=2026-04-21 |title=Defence ministry signs contracts for procurement of critical equipment for T-72, T-90 tanks |url=https://www.fortuneindia.com/business-news/defence-ministry-signs-contracts-for-procurement-of-critical-equipment-for-t-72-t-90-tanks/133570 |access-date=2026-04-21 |website=Fortune India |language=en}} ==Railways/metro rolling stock== [[File:East_West_Metro_Kolkata_rake.jpg|thumb|200px|right|BEML ATO rolling stock for [[Kolkata Metro Green Line]]{{Cite web|url=https://themetrorailguy.com/2020/06/17/beml-flags-off-final-kolkata-metro-line-2-train-set/|title=BEML Flags Off Final Kolkata Metro Line-2 Train-set|date=17 June 2020|accessdate=24 May 2023}} ]] [[File:BEML SSEMU Photo 2.jpg|thumb|200px|right|BEML SSEMU]] [[File:Mumbai_Metro_at_Gundavali_Station.jpg|thumb|right|BEML rolling stock for [[Line 2 (Mumbai Metro)|Mumbai Metro Yellow Line]] ]] BEML Limited's Rail Coach Factory situated in Bangalore, India, is the first all-steel integrated rail coach factory established by Government of India in 1948. This factory was established to indigenously manufacture the passenger rail coach for Indian Railways.{{cite web | url=https://www.bemlindia.in/rail-metro/ | title=RAIL & METRO – BEML India }} BEML manufactures rolling stock for [[Indian Railways]] as well as for metros since the 1980s.{{cite news|title=MMRDA awards Rs 3,015 cr contract to BEML for rolling stock on|url=https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/news/national/mmrda-awards-rs-3015-cr-contract-to-beml-for-rolling-stock-on/article25586866.ece|work=[[Business Line]]|date=24 November 2018}} BEML has supplied over '''2,000 metro coaches''' to various metro systems, including those in Delhi, Jaipur, Kolkata, Bengaluru, and Mumbai.{{Cite web|url=https://www.pib.gov.in/PressNoteDetails.aspx?id=155002&NoteId=155002&ModuleId=3|title=Press Note Details: Press Information Bureau|date=May 2024|accessdate=August 9, 2025}} The company supplied about 140 cars to DMRC using transfer of technology from Hyundai ROTEM. [[Jaipur Metro]] has also ordered to manufacture, supply, test, and commission 10 train sets of four cars each, totaling 40 cars, for the Jaipur Metro Project. BEML Limited has bagged a contract from the Railway Board for the design, manufacturing, supply, testing, and commissioning of rakes of some stainless steel AC Electrical Multiple Unit (SSEMU) coaches worth Rs 31 crore.{{Cite web|url=https://www.business-standard.com/article/companies/beml-bags-railway-board-order-worth-rs-31-crore-108090800020_1.html|title=BEML bags Railway Board order worth Rs 31 crore|date=8 September 2008|website=www.business-standard.com|access-date=24 May 2023}} BEML has started supplying metro train sets to the East-West corridor of [[Kolkata Metro]] (KMRCL). The present order in hand from KMRCL is for 14 train sets of six cars each. BEML receives letter of acceptance (LoA) for design, manufacture, and commissioning of 10 Trainsets (Sleeper) on [[Vande Bharat Express|Vande Bharat]] platform. The total value of the order is Rs 675 crore.{{Cite web|url=https://www.businessworld.in/article/BEML-Receives-LoA-Worth-Rs-675-Cr-For-Vande-Bharat-Trainsets-/15-05-2023-476590/|title=BEML Receives LoA Worth Rs 675 Cr For Vande Bharat Trainsets|date=15 May 2023|website=www.businessworld.in|access-date=28 May 2023}} The [[Integral Coach Factory]] (ICF) awarded BEML a ₹866.87-[[crore]] contract to construct two high-speed train sets. They will be the first train sets produced in India with a top speed of 350 kmph. They are expected to be delivered in 2026. Each coach will cost ₹27.86 crore.{{Cite news |last=Porecha |first=Maitri |date=2024-10-15 |title=BEML awarded contract worth ₹866.87 crore to build indigenous high-speed trains |url=https://www.thehindu.com/business/beml-awarded-contract-worth-86687-crore-to-build-indigenous-high-speed-trains/article68756688.ece |access-date=2025-01-11 |work=The Hindu |language=en-IN |issn=0971-751X}}{{Cite web |last=Pall |first=Samreen |date=16 October 2024 |title=BEML Bags Rs 866.87 Crore Contract for India's First Homegrown High-Speed Trains |url=https://www.news18.com/auto/beml-bags-rs-866-87-crore-contract-for-indias-first-homegrown-high-speed-trains-9087402.html |access-date=2025-01-11 |website=News18 |language=en}}{{Cite web |last=Service |first=Express News |date=2024-10-16 |title=BEML bags Rs 866.87 crore contract for two bullet train sets |url=https://www.newindianexpress.com/states/karnataka/2024/Oct/16/beml-bags-rs-86687-crorecontract-for-two-bullet-train-sets |access-date=2025-01-11 |website=The New Indian Express |language=en}} BEML is one of the leading manufacturers of rail and metro coaches. Metro systems using BEML rolling stock are: * '''[[Delhi Metro]]''': The company has supplied over 1,250 coaches to the Delhi Metro. * '''[[Namma Metro]]''' (Bengaluru): Over 325 coaches have been supplied, with an additional order for 360 more coaches (60 train sets) for Phases 2, 2A, and 2B. * '''[[Mumbai Metro]]''': BEML has supplied 378 coaches for Lines [[Line 2 (Mumbai Metro)|2]] and [[Line 7 (Mumbai Metro)|7]]. * '''[[Kolkata Metro]]''': BEML has supplied 102 coaches for the [[Green Line (Kolkata Metro)|Green Line]]. * '''[[Jaipur Metro]]''': BEML has supplied 40 coaches. == Infrastructure == [[File:MakeInIndia-BEML-205-Dumper.jpg|thumb|BEML 205 dumper]] BEML operates in three major business verticals associated with equipment manufacturing: * Mining & Construction * Defence & Aerospace * Rail & Metro In addition to the above, there are strategic business units (SBUs): * Trading Division for dealing in non-company products * International Business Division for export activities * Aerospace Division for design services for the aviation sector BEML has the following manufacturing units spread over four locations: * Kolar Gold Fields (KGF) Complex (around 100 km from [[Bengaluru]]) ** Hubli Earth Moving Division ** Rail Coach Unit II ** Heavy Fabrication Unit ** Hydraulic & Powerline Division * Mysore Complex (around 130 km from [[Bengaluru]]) ** Truck Division ** Engine Division ** Aerospace Manufacturing Division * Bengaluru Complex - Rail & Metro Division *Palakkad Complex [[Kerala State]] - defence products manufacturing **BEML - [[Tatra (company)|Tatra Trucks]] 12x12, 10x10, 8x8, 6x6, 4x4 & variants **Pontoon bridge system **Ground support vehicles for guided missile programme **Heavy, medium, and light recovery vehicles **50T trailer for tank transportation **Mil rail coaches and mil wagons **Apart from the above, Railway parts and aggregates are planned for manufacture * Vignyan Industries, a subsidiary located at Tarikere (around 300 km from Bengaluru) - steel castings ==Management== Shri Shantanu Roy assumed charge as Chairman & Managing Director at BEML Ltd from 01.08. 2023. Prior to assuming his present position, Shri Shantanu Roy was Director (Mining and Construction Business) after the superannuation of Shri M V Rajasekhar, the predecessor CMD of BEML Ltd, since 1 Feb 2021.{{Cite news|url=https://www.thehindu.com/news/cities/bangalore/dkhota-is-next-beml-chief/article8049967.ece/|title=D.K.Hota is next BEML chief|newspaper=The Hindu|date=31 December 2015|last1=d. s|first1=Madhumathi}} == Competitors == The main competitor for BEML is in the private sector, which has its own manufacturing units in [[India]], thus participating in the 'Make in India' initiative. The major source of income of BEML comes from Mining equipment. * [[Action Construction Equipment]], a [[Faridabad]] based company * [[Armoured Vehicles Nigam|AVANI]] * [[JCB (heavy equipment manufacturer)|JCB]] * [[Caterpillar Inc.]] ==Defense vehicles== [[File:Arjun_ARRV.jpg|thumb|Arjun ARRV Armored vehicle manufactured by collaboration of BEML and CVRDE]] BEML manufactures [[DRDO]] designed HMV, Arjun ARRV, Mobile Standby Command Post Vehicle (MSCPV) * BEML Armored Vehicle [[Arjun (tank)#Armour|Arjun ARRV]] * BEML HMV [[All-wheel drive vehicle|12×12]] ([[Gross Vehicle Weight]]: 65 tons; developed by [[VRDE]]){{Cite news |date=2025-03-27 |title=BEML launches indigenous high-mobility vehicle 12x12 to strengthen India's defence capabilities |url=https://www.aninews.in/news/national/general-news/beml-launches-indigenous-high-mobility-vehicle-12x12-to-strengthen-indias-defence-capabilities20250327230821/ |access-date=2025-03-29 |work=[[Asian News International|ANI]]}} == Trailers == [[File:Defence Expo 2020-11.jpg|thumb|BEML BD50 [[bulldozer]] loaded on a BEML 20T trailer displayed at defense expo 2020 in [[Lucknow]].]] * 20 T 20 Ton capacity 8-wheeled [[Lowboy (trailer)|lowboy trailer]] developed for transportation of construction equipment on rough train. Can be coupled with [[Tractor unit|tractor]] via 4 wheeled [[Dolly (trailer)|dolly]].{{Cite web |title=BEML 20T trailer |url=https://alumni.bemlindia.in/writereaddata/Downloads/2017090512482020T%20low%20deck%20full%20trailer.pdf |access-date=2023-09-06 |archive-date=6 September 2023 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230906080313/https://alumni.bemlindia.in/writereaddata/Downloads/2017090512482020T%20low%20deck%20full%20trailer.pdf |url-status=bot: unknown }} * 50T 50 Ton capacity 24-wheeled lowboy trailers developed for the transportation of mid-weight tanks on rough train. Can be coupled with a tractor via an 8-wheeled jeep dolly.{{Cite web |title=BEML 50T trailer |url=https://alumni.bemlindia.in/writereaddata/Downloads/2017090512490650T%20Trailer%20for%20Tank%20Transport.pdf |access-date=2023-09-06 |archive-date=6 September 2023 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230906075822/https://alumni.bemlindia.in/writereaddata/Downloads/2017090512490650T%20Trailer%20for%20Tank%20Transport.pdf |url-status=bot: unknown }} * 70T 70 Ton capacity 5-axle row [[hydraulic modular trailer]] developed for transportation of heavy tanks on rough train. Can be coupled with [[ballast tractor]] via [[Drawbar (haulage)|drawbar]] coupling.{{Cite web |title=BEML 70T trailer |url=https://alumni.bemlindia.in/writereaddata/Downloads/2017092311472370%20T%20Trailer.pdf |access-date=2023-09-06 |archive-date=6 September 2023 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230906082629/https://alumni.bemlindia.in/writereaddata/Downloads/2017092311472370%20T%20Trailer.pdf |url-status=bot: unknown }} == Controversy == In 2014, BEML made headlines when former army chief [[V. K. Singh|VK Singh]] alleged he was offered a bribe of 14 crores to clear sub-standard trucks for the army. These trucks, known as [[Tatra (company)|Tatra trucks]], are supplied to BEML via a London agent for assembly. The CBI was investigating allegations of the bribe, as well as the alleged violation of basic rules by BEML, where defense equipment must be purchased directly from the manufacturer without involving middlemen.{{Cite web |title=BEML head slammed by govt for threatening to sue ex army chief |url=https://www.ndtv.com/india-news/beml-head-slammed-by-govt-for-threatening-to-sue-ex-army-chief-487051 |access-date= |website=NDTV.com}} == References == {{reflist}} == External links == {{commons category}} *{{Official website|https://www.bemlindia.in}} {{Finance links | name = BEML Limited | google = NSE:BEML | symbol = BEML.NS | yahoo = BEML.NS | reuters = BEML.NS }} {{Bangalore topics}} {{Public Sector Undertakings in India}} {{authority control}} {{Coord|12.971403|77.659518|display=title}} {{DEFAULTSORT:Beml}} [[Category:Coach and wagon manufacturers of India]] [[Category:Manufacturing companies based in Bengaluru]] [[Category:Construction equipment manufacturers of India]] [[Category:Government-owned companies of India]] [[Category:Defence companies of India]] [[Category:Truck manufacturers of India]] [[Category:Indian brands]] [[Category:1964 establishments in Mysore State]] [[Category:Companies listed on the National Stock Exchange of India]] [[Category:Companies listed on the Bombay Stock Exchange]]
extract: BEML Limited, formerly Bharat Earth Movers Limited, is an Indian public sector undertaking which manufactures a variety of heavy equipment, such as that used for earth moving, railways, transport, and mining. It is headquartered in Bengaluru, Karnataka. BEML is Asia's second-largest manufacturer of earth moving equipment. Its stock trades on the National Stock Exchange of India under the symbol "BEML", and on the Bombay Stock Exchange under the code "500048".
